blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning systems make it possible to reproduce a recognizable voice from a short recording and attach it to arbitrary virtual characters. Prior work suggests that familiar vocal identity can carry over associated personality impressions to new targets such as robots or virtual characters. However, these works have mainly examined familiarity and personalization effects rather than directly testing whether a cloned familiar voice systematically transfers personality impressions to an embodied virtual character. Such transference raises the concern that cloned voices could be used to manipulate people into engaging with virtual characters as capable social actors. Across two studies, we investigated whether personality impressions transfer when a virtual character speaks with the cloned voice of a familiar person. Study 1 examined this question in a real-world university setting using the cloned voice of a lecturer familiar to the participating students. Study 2 examined the same question online using voices of social media content creators and members of their communities. Drawing on the concepts of identity activation, trait transfer, and person reconstruction, we show that evidence of personality transfer was limited in both studies. Observed effects were selective and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. In the online study in particular, recognizable voice identity cues activated expectations about the speaker but did not reconstruct the broader person impression. Qualitative responses further indicated that judgments were frequently shaped by perceived artificiality and by whether voice and appearance fit together. Our findings moderate common concerns that cloned voices straightforwardly manipulate people into perceiving artificial characters as capable social actors.
blocks.zh: 最近零镜头语音克隆系统的进步使得能够从短录音中再现一个可识别的声音并附在任意的虚拟字符上. 之前的工作表明,熟悉的相声身份可以将相联的个性印象带入机器人或虚拟人物等新目标. 然而,这些作品主要研究了熟悉和个性化的特效,而不是直接测试一个被克隆的熟悉的声音是否系统地将个性印象传递给一个被体现的虚拟人物. 这种转移引起人们的关切,即克隆的声音可能被用来操纵人们作为有能力的社会行为者与虚拟人物打交道。 在两项研究中,我们调查了一个虚拟角色与熟人克隆的声音说话时,人格印象是否转移. 第1个研究在现实世界的大学环境中利用学员熟悉的讲师的克隆声音来研究这个问题。 第二研究利用社交媒体内容创造者及其社区成员的声音,在网上审查了同一问题。 根据身份激活、特征转移和人员重建的概念,我们表明,在两项研究中,人格转移的证据都很有限。 观察到的效应是有选择性的,没有将不同特征或研究背景加以概括。 尤其是在线研究中,可识别的语音身份提示激发了对演讲者的期望,但没有重新塑造更广泛的个人印象。 定性答复还表明,判决往往由所认为的人为性以及声音和外观是否一致而形成。 我们的调查结果缓和了共同的关切,即克隆声音直接操纵人们将人造人物视为有能力的社会行为者。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: From short speech samples, listeners infer personality traits and social qualities such as trustworthiness, dominance, and competence [ 25 ] . When a voice is familiar, perception extends beyond acoustic inference: Familiar voices are stored in memory with sufficient specificity for robust identity recognition and activate stored person-specific knowledge, including trait attributions and relational associations [ 14 ] .
blocks.zh: 从简短的演讲样本中,听众推断出个性特征和社会素质,如可信赖性,支配地位,和能力[25]. 当一个声音熟悉时,感知超越了声学推论: 熟悉的声音被存储在记忆中,具有足够的特异性,可以进行强烈的身份识别,激活存储的针对特定个人的知识,包括特征归属和关系关联[14].

blocks.en: Research has now shown that this stored knowledge can be activated on the basis of particular cues alone, leading us to project person-based attributions from familiar individuals onto new targets, such as when we feel an instant liking for a new person who resembles a dear friend in some way [ 15 , 40 ] . Since hearing a familiar voice can trigger person-specific representations or associated attributions even without explicit identification [ 4 , 21 ] , it is likely that familiar voices can form such cues as well. If they can, then it is possible that the attachment of familiar voices to new targets can bias our judgments of these targets.
blocks.zh: 现在的研究表明,这种存储的知识可以仅仅根据特定的提示来激活,从而导致我们从熟悉的个人到新的目标上实现基于个人的归属,例如,当我们感到一个新人瞬间喜欢他在某种程度上像一个亲爱的朋友时[15,40]。 由于听到熟悉的声音即使没有明确的识别[4,21],也能触发针对个人的表述或相关归属,因此熟悉的声音也有可能形成这样的提示. 如果可以的话,那么将熟悉的声音附在新的目标上,有可能使我们对这些目标的判断产生偏见。

blocks.en: From a social robotics and AI perspective, this is an interesting possibility, especially now that recent work suggests that we evaluate synthetic voices along similar social dimensions as we do natural human voices [ 39 ] . If we already infer personality traits and social qualities from synthetic voices, what would happen when we provide robots or virtual characters not just with human voices, but with voices of humans that we are already familiar with? Would it activate our stored person-knowledge, biasing our evaluation of the capacities of that system to function as a social actor, thereby increasing our willingness to trust and engage with that system?
blocks.zh: 从社会机器人和AI的角度来看,这是一个有趣的可能性,特别是现在最近的工作表明,我们像做自然人类声音一样,按照类似的社会层面评价合成声音[39]. 如果我们已经从合成声音中推导出个性特征和社会品质,那么当我们提供机器人或虚拟角色时,会怎样,不仅提供人类的声音,而且提供我们已经熟悉的人类的声音? 它是否会激活我们储存的个人知识,偏见我们对该体系作为社会行为者发挥作用的能力的评估,从而增加我们信任和接触该体系的意愿?

blocks.en: Prior work has demonstrated that voice design can shape the appeal, trustworthiness, and perceived believability of virtual agents and characters [ 7 , 12 ] . And, even when just a synthetic voice is used, similarity-based voice design has been shown to increase robot likability (both with and without conscious awareness of the similarity) [ 16 ] . In addition, related work suggests that character-inspired voices can shape user engagement and evaluations of conversational AI systems [ 9 ] . Based on these findings, the hypothesis can be drawn that the use of a familiar voice is likely to further increase our willingness to engage with an artificial system. What this seems to depend on, however, and what the aforementioned findings do not yet establish, is whether a cloned familiar voice can systematically transfer personality impressions to an embodied artificial character and whether the coupling of a known voice with a visible body amplifies such transfer.
blocks.zh: 先前的作品表明,语音设计可以塑造虚拟代理和人物的吸引力,可信赖性,以及感知的可信性[7,12]. 而且,即使仅仅使用一个合成声音,基于相似性的声音设计也已被显示可以提高机器人的可亲性(无论有无意识地意识到相似性)[16]. 此外,相关工作表明,受人物启发的声音可以塑造用户参与和评价对话AI系统[9]. 基于这些调查结果,可以得出一种假设,即使用熟悉的声音有可能进一步增强我们与人工系统接触的意愿。 然而,这似乎取决于以及上述调查结果尚未证实的是,一个克隆的熟悉的声音是否能够系统地将人格印象转移到一个已体现的人工特征上,以及将已知的声音与可见的身体结合是否会放大这种转移。

blocks.en: This is an important question to answer, especially given recent advances in zero-shot voice cloning. Such systems generate realistic speech from short reference recordings [ 6 , 29 ] , making it possible for recognizable voices to be reproduced and attached to arbitrary characters across a variety of contexts. Besides the ethical concerns raised by the fact that there are not yet adequate policies in place to protect us from having our voices cloned and used without consent, 1 1 1 Voice cloning detaches vocal identity from the embodied person and makes its reuse scalable across platforms. Public debates about deepfakes and voice cloning highlight perceived threats to identity and trust. Beyond authentication risks [ 41 ] , qualitative research documents fears of identity displacement, fragmentation of selfhood, and loss of control over vocal representation [ 8 , 22 , 23 ] . there is also the worry that the implementation of familiar voices in Human-Robot and AI interaction can constitute a dark pattern [ 37 ] . 2 2 2 We adopt here the definition of a dark pattern proposed by Shamsudhin & Jotterand [ 37 ] , who define a dark pattern as a persuasive design of which “(1) the intent to persuade must be necessary, (2) the resulting user action is not in the user’s best interest and is in the interest of the persuader, and (3) the methods employed are deceptive and covert” (p. 96). After all, if familiar vocal identity indeed carries over associated personality impressions in a reliable way, then designers could strategically activate character traits through voice selection alone, thereby manipulating users to engage with their artificial systems in ways that are not necessarily in their best interest. Given these pressing ethical concerns, it is thus important that we find out whether voice-based familiarity provides a plausible pathway for attribution transfer.
blocks.zh: 这是一个需要回答的重要问题,特别是考虑到最近零镜头语音克隆的进步. 这种系统从简短的参考录音[6,29]中产生现实的言论,使得可以识别的声音能够被复制,并附在各种背景的任意字符上. 除了尚未制定适当的政策来保护我们不被不经同意复制和使用我们的声音之外,111个声音克隆将声音特征与被化人隔开,使其在平台上的重复使用。 关于深层假象和语音克隆的公开辩论突出了对身份和信任的预期威胁。 除了认证风险[41]之外,定性研究文件担心身份转移、自我分裂和声响代表丧失控制权[8、22、23]。 人们还担心,在Human-Robot和AI互动中执行熟悉的声音可构成一种黑暗模式[37] 2 2 2 我们在此采用Shamsudhin & Jotterand[37]提出的暗色图案的定义,他将暗色图案定义为一种有说服力的设计, " (1) 说服的意图必须是必要的,(2) 由此产生的用户行动不符合用户的最佳利益,也符合说服者的利益,(3) 所使用的方法是欺骗和隐蔽的 " (第96页)。 毕竟,如果熟悉的声优身份确实以可靠的方式承载了相关的人格印象,那么设计师们就可以独自通过语音选择从战略上激活性格特征,从而操纵用户以不一定符合自己最大利益的方式与自己的人工系统进行接触. 鉴于这些紧迫的伦理问题,我们必须查明,基于声音的熟悉是否为归属转移提供了一种可行的途径。

blocks.en: In this paper, two studies are presented that provide initial insights into the possible effects that the use of familiar voices can have on our evaluation of an artificial system as a capable social actor. We thereby make three contributions to existing research: (1) We provide empirical evidence across two contexts that familiar voice cloning yields only small and trait-selective alignment effects rather than robust person-consistent evaluations. (2) We show, through qualitative analysis, that judgments are often dominated by perceived artificiality and voice–appearance mismatch. (3) We derive practical guidance for responsible character design by identifying boundary conditions under which familiar voice cloning is unlikely to support social evaluation and may backfire.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,提出了两项研究报告,对使用熟悉的声音可能对我们评价人工系统作为有能力的社会行为者可能产生的影响提供了初步的见解。 因此,我们对现有的研究作出了三项贡献: (1) 我们在两种情况下提供经验证据,即熟悉的语音克隆只产生小的、有特色的选择性调整效果,而不是强有力的与人一致的评价。 (2) 我们通过定性分析表明,判断往往被人造和声音的不匹配所支配。 (3)我们通过确定熟悉的语音克隆不大可能支持社会评价并可能起反作用的边界条件,为负责任的人物设计提供实际指导。

blocks.en: In the following, we first introduce our main concepts (section 2 ) and present the two studies and their results (sections 3 – 4 ). Based on these results, we argue that familiar voices can influence evaluations of artificial systems as social actors, but that this influence is selective, context-dependent, and insufficient to support straightforward assumptions of robust personality transfer or person reconstruction. We end by discussing limitations of the present studies and outline directions for future work (sections 5 – 6 ).
blocks.zh: 在下面,我们首先介绍我们的主要概念(第2节),并介绍两项研究及其结果(第3至4节)。 基于这些结果,我们提出,熟悉的声音可以影响对人造系统作为社会行为者的评价,但这种影响是选择性的,取决于背景的,不足以支持关于强健的人格转移或人重建的直截了当的假设. 最后,我们讨论本研究报告的局限性,并概述今后工作的方向(第5至第6节)。

blocks.en: 2 Conceptual Framework
blocks.zh: 2 概念框架

blocks.en: To clarify the possible effects of familiar voices in robots and virtual characters, it is useful to distinguish between three conceptually different outcomes.
blocks.zh: 为了澄清机器人和虚拟人物中熟悉的声音可能产生的影响,区分三个概念上不同的结果是有用的.

blocks.en: Identity activation occurs when a familiar voice triggers recognition or retrieval of a stored representation of the original speaker. Hearing the voice can activate associated person knowledge, expectations, and affective responses linked to that individual. Such activation may influence how the artificial character is perceived or evaluated. However, the influence remains indirect and does not necessarily result in consistent attribution of the original speaker’s personality traits to the new target [ 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 当熟悉的语音触发对存储的原发音代表的识别或检索时,身份激活即发生. 听到声音可以激活相关人员的知识、期望和与该个人相关的感人反应。 这种激活可能影响对人工特征的认识或评价。 然而,这种影响仍然是间接的,不一定导致将原发言人的个性特征一致地归于新的目标[20]。

blocks.en: Trait transfer (as used in this paper) refers to a pattern in which evaluations of an artificial character converge toward trait and social judgments associated with a familiar speaker when the character uses a cloned version of that speaker’s voice. Importantly, this is not meant as projection in the classic sense of attributing one’s own characteristics to others. Rather, it describes an attributional carryover in which activated person knowledge about the familiar speaker systematically biases judgments of the new target.
blocks.zh: Trait transfer(如本文所用)是指一种模式,即当某个人物使用克隆版的演讲者的声音时,对某个人为人物的评价与熟悉的演讲者相关的特征和社会判断趋于一致。 重要的是,这并非是将自己的特征归咎于他人的经典意义上的预测。 相反,它描述了一种归属性传承,在这种传承中,被激活的人对熟悉的发言者有系统偏见地判断新目标。

blocks.en: Person reconstruction represents the strongest possible form of transfer. In this case, the familiar voice cue would reinstate a broader person impression, such that listeners evaluate the artificial character in ways that closely resemble their internal model of the original individual across multiple traits and social judgments [ 15 , 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 人员重建是最强的转移形式。 在此情况下,熟悉的语音提示将恢复更广泛的人印象,使听众在评价人造特征时,其方式与他们原有个人的内部模式非常相似,具有多种特征和社会判断[15、32]。

blocks.en: These outcomes differ in strength and theoretical implication. Identity activation concerns the retrieval of person-related expectations, trait transfer concerns selective attribution of characteristics, and person reconstruction would imply that an isolated perceptual cue can sustain a coherent person representation. The studies presented in this paper examine whether familiar voice cloning produces evidence for trait transfer and whether it approaches the stronger case of person reconstruction in evaluations of embodied artificial characters.
blocks.zh: 这些结果在强度和理论含义上有所不同。 身份激活涉及与个人有关的预期的检索,特征转移涉及特征的选择性归属,个人重建将意味着孤立的感知提示可以维持连贯的个人代表性。 本文中介绍的研究审查了熟悉的语音克隆是否为特征转移提供了证据,以及它是否在对人文人物的评价中采用了更强有力的人文重建案例。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes the main design characteristics of the two studies.
We use the empirical studies as a case to examine how voice-based identity cues operate in embodied characters.
blocks.zh:
表1概述了这两项研究的主要设计特点。
我们以经验研究为例,审查基于声音的身份提示如何在包含的字符中运作。

blocks.en: Table 1: Overview of the two studies.
blocks.zh: 表1:两项研究概览。

blocks.en: Participants first rated a familiar real person from memory to capture their baseline internal person model. They then evaluated the same virtual character in two voice conditions: a known-voice clone and a cloned unknown voice . Visual appearance and spoken content were held constant, making voice the only manipulated factor. The unknown voice was unfamiliar to participants and served as control voice for the same character and speech content.
blocks.zh: 与会者首先从记忆中给一个熟悉的真人评分,以捕捉他们的基线内人模型. 他们随后在两个语音条件下评价同一个虚拟字符:一个已知的语音克隆和一个克隆的未知语音. 视觉外观和口语内容保持不变,使语音成为唯一被操纵的因素. 不知名的声音对与会者来说是陌生的,并且充当同一字符和语音内容的控制声音。

blocks.en: If the known-voice clone activates stored person knowledge and supports attribution transfer, character ratings should be closer to real-person ratings in the known-voice clone condition than in the unknown voice condition. We operationalized this as smaller absolute distances between known-person and character ratings across personality traits and social evaluation measures, indicating greater alignment between the remembered person model and the evaluated character.
blocks.zh: 如果已知的语音克隆激活存储的人物知识并支持归属转移,那么在已知的语音克隆条件中,角色评级应该比在未知的语音条件中更接近真人评级. 我们把这一点作为不同人格特征的已知人物和人物评级与社会评价措施之间的绝对距离缩小,表明被铭记人物模式与被评价人物之间更加一致。

blocks.en: The order of the two character conditions was randomized in Study 1 and Study 2; the memory-based familiar-person rating always preceded the character evaluations.
blocks.zh: 两个字符条件的顺序在"研究1"和"研究2"中随机排列;基于内存的熟悉人物评级总是在角色评价之前.

blocks.en: Study 1 was an exploratory study using a university lecturer as the familiar person. Participants were recruited in a university teaching context and completed the study during a lecture or tutorial using their own smartphones and headphones. The familiar person was the lecturer whose course they attended. Of 18 completed questionnaires, one participant was excluded for not knowing the lecturer, leaving 17 valid responses. Participants had a mean age of 22.19 years ( SD = 2.99; range: 20–32).
blocks.zh: 第1研究是利用大学讲师作为熟悉人的探索性研究。 学员在大学教学中被录用,并在讲座或辅导期间用自己的智能手机和耳机完成了学习. 熟悉的人是他们参加课程的讲师。 在18份填写完毕的调查表中,一名参加者因不了解讲师而被排除在外,留下17份有效答复。 参与者的平均年龄为22.19岁(SD = 2.99;范围:20-32)。

blocks.en: Study 2 tested the same design online using the voices of two social media content creators. Participants were recruited through creator-related online communities, primarily Reddit, supplemented by mailing lists and social media posts. Of 208 participants who started the survey, 65 valid responses remained after applying preregistered exclusion criteria, including incomplete responses, failed attention checks, and insufficient creator recognition. Participants had a mean age of 27.9 years ( SD = 6.38; range: 19–52).
blocks.zh: 第二研究利用两个社交媒体内容创造者的声音在线测试了同一设计. 与会者是通过与创作者有关的在线社区(主要是Reddit)招聘的,辅之以邮寄名单和社交媒体帖子。 在开始调查的208名参与者中,65份有效答复在适用预先登记的排除标准之后仍然存在,包括答复不完整、注意检查失败以及创作者认可不足。 参与者的平均年龄为27.9岁(SD = 6.38;范围:19-52)。

blocks.en: At the beginning of Study 2, participants completed a familiarity check for the two selected creators and indicated which one they knew better. Actual familiarity was verified by requiring correct identification of both the creator’s real name and artist name, as well as content consumption within the previous three months. Participants who failed these preregistered criteria were excluded. After rating the selected creator from memory, participants evaluated the virtual character in the known-voice and unknown-voice conditions.
blocks.zh: 在第二期研究开始时,学员们完成了对两位被选中的创作者的熟悉程度检查,并表明他们更了解哪一位。 通过要求正确识别创作者的真名和艺名以及前三个月内的内容消费,对实际熟悉程度进行了核实。 未达到这些预先登记标准的与会者被排除在外。 在对被选中的创作者从内存中进行评分后,参与者评价了已知语音和未知语音条件下的虚拟字符.

blocks.en: Study 2 was preregistered. 3 3 3 https://aspredicted.org/zy8j9m.pdf All participants took part voluntarily and provided informed consent before participation. Voices were cloned with permission from the respective voice owners or from materials explicitly authorized for the study.
blocks.zh: 第2期研究已预先登记。 所有与会者都自愿参加,并在参加前获得知情同意。 声音的复制得到了相关语音拥有者的许可,或来自明确授权进行研究的材料。

blocks.en: 3.1 Measures
blocks.zh: 3.1 措施

blocks.en: Study 1 assessed Big Five other-ratings using the German Big Five Inventory adapted for rating others [ 31 , 43 ] (21 items; five-point Likert scales; negatively keyed items reverse-coded). Study 2 used brief Big Five scales adapted for other-ratings [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 研究1使用适应其他评级的德国大五编目对大五级其他评级进行了评估[31,43](21项;5分Irikrt比例表;负键项目反向编码). 研究2使用了适合其他评级的简短的五大尺度[30]。

blocks.en: Likability was measured with a multi-item scale [ 11 , 42 ] , and competence with established person-perception items [ 5 ] . Study 2 additionally measured trust [ 33 ] . Likability and competence used seven-point Likert scales in Study 1; Study 2 followed the instruments’ original response formats.
blocks.zh: 对可诉性进行了多项目尺度[11,42]的衡量,对确定的人的看法项目进行了能力衡量[5]。 研究2 额外衡量的信任 [33]. 第1项研究采用了七点相似度表;第2项研究采用了文书最初的反应格式。

blocks.en: 3.2 Stimuli
blocks.zh: 3.2 刺激

blocks.en: Two different virtual characters were used across the studies (Figure 1 ). Within each study, visual appearance and spoken content were held constant across voice conditions. The order of voice conditions was randomized.
blocks.zh: 在整个研究中使用了两个不同的虚拟字符(图1). 在每项研究中,视觉外观和口语内容在语音条件上保持不变。 语音条件的顺序是随机的.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Virtual characters used in the studies. Left: Character used in Study 1 (exploratory real-world study). Right: Character used in Study 2 (online social media study). In both studies, visual appearance and spoken content were held constant across voice conditions.
blocks.zh: 图 1:研究中使用的虚拟字符. 左:研究1(探索现实世界研究)中使用的字符. Right:研究2(在线社交媒体研究)中使用的字符. 在这两项研究中,视觉外观和口语内容在语音条件上保持不变。

blocks.en: Voice clones were generated from short reference recordings using zero-shot voice cloning systems [ 6 , 29 ] : OpenVoice in Study 1 [ 29 ] and XTTSv2 in Study 2 [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 语音克隆是利用零镜头语音克隆系统[6,29]从简短的参考录音生成的: OpenVoice in Studio 1 [29] 和XTTSv2 in Studio 2 [6].

blocks.en: The virtual character and lip synchronization were created with MeLaX [ 44 ] . Stimulus duration differed between studies (Table 1 ): Study 1 used shorter, phonetically balanced sentences [ 18 ] , whereas Study 2 used longer statements [ 28 ] to support more reliable personality judgments following participant feedback from Study 1.
blocks.zh: 虚拟字符和唇语同步是与MeLAX[44]创建的. 不同研究的刺激期限不同(表1): 第1项研究使用了较短的、在语言上平衡的句子[18],而第2项研究则使用了较长的语句[28],支持在第1项研究的参与者反馈后作出更可靠的个性判断。

blocks.en: 3.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 分析

blocks.en: Study 1 was exploratory and used paired t-tests or Wilcoxon signed-rank tests depending on the distribution of the difference scores. Study 2 followed the preregistered directional analysis plan, using one-tailed paired t-tests or one-tailed Wilcoxon signed-rank tests to test whether distances were smaller in the known-voice than in the unknown-voice condition. Distances were calculated as absolute differences between person and character ratings on each scale.
blocks.zh: 研究1是探索性的,根据差异分数的分布,使用配对T测试或Wilcoxon签名排名测试. 研究2遵循预先注册的方向分析计划,采用单尾配对T测试或单尾配对的Wilcoxon签名排名测试,以测试已知语音的距离是否小于未知语音的状态. 距离被计算为每个尺度上人物和人物评级的绝对差异.

blocks.en: Open-ended responses from Study 2 were analyzed using qualitative content analysis [ 24 ] , focusing on voice recognition, voice–appearance fit, perceived artificiality, and emotional tone.
blocks.zh: 利用定性内容分析分析[24]分析了研究2的不限名额答复,重点是语音识别、语音的出现、人造的感知和情感语气。

blocks.en: Given its exploratory nature, Study 1 used no correction for multiple comparisons. Study 2 tested the directional hypothesis separately for each outcome according to the preregistered analysis plan, 3 also without correction for multiple comparisons.
blocks.zh: 鉴于其探索性性质,第1项研究未对多重比较作任何更正。 研究2根据预先注册的分析计划分别测试了每个结果的方向假说,3同样没有更正多次比较.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Figure 2: Absolute distances between known-person ratings and character ratings for the unknown-voice and known-voice conditions. Panel A shows Study 1 ( n = 17 n=17 ); Panel B shows Study 2 ( n = 65 n=65 ). Violins show distance distributions, and horizontal lines indicate medians. In Panel A, BFI and social evaluation distances are shown on separate y-axes because the underlying response scales differed.
blocks.zh: 图 2:无名之人收视率与无名之人收视率的绝对距离. A小组显示研究1(n=17n=17);B小组显示研究2(n=65n=65)。 阴极显示距离分布,水平线表示中位数. 在小组A中,BFI和社会评价距离分别显示在y轴上,因为基本反应尺度不同。

blocks.en: 4.1 Study 1 (Lecturer, n = 17 n=17 )
blocks.zh: 4.1 学习 1(Lecturer,n=17n=17) (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: Wilcoxon signed-rank tests showed significantly smaller distances in the known-voice condition for likability ( W = 11.5 W=11.5 , p = .010 p=.010 , rank-biserial r = − .75 r=-.75 ) and agreeableness ( W = 16.0 W=16.0 , p = .038 p=.038 , rank-biserial r = − .59 r=-.59 ). Likability distances were lower in the known-voice condition ( M = 1.96 M=1.96 , S ​ D = 1.35 SD=1.35 , M ​ d ​ n = 2.00 Mdn=2.00 ) than in the unknown-voice condition ( M = 2.56 M=2.56 , S ​ D = 1.32 SD=1.32 , M ​ d ​ n = 2.60 Mdn=2.60 ); the same pattern was found for agreeableness ( M = 1.28 M=1.28 , S ​ D = 1.05 SD=1.05 , M ​ d ​ n = 1.00 Mdn=1.00 vs. M = 1.74 M=1.74 , S ​ D = 0.92 SD=0.92 , M ​ d ​ n = 2.00 Mdn=2.00 ). Competence and the remaining Big Five dimensions were not significant (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: Wilcoxon签名排名测试显示,在已知的可读性语音条件(W = 11.5 W = 11.5,p = 010,p = 010)和可读性(W = 16.0 W = 16.6,p = 038,p = 038,p = 2.60 Mdn = 2.60 Mdn = 2.60)中,可读性距离明显较小。 在已知的语音条件(M = 1.96 M = 1.96,S D = 1.35 SD = 1.35,M d = 2.00 Mdn = 2.00)比在未知的语音条件(M = 2.56 M = 2.56,S D = 1.32 SD = 1.32,Md = 2.60 Md = 2.60 Md = 2.28,SD = 1.05 05 Md = 1.00)中,可读性距离较低。

blocks.en: 4.2 Study 2 (Content creators, n = 65 n=65 , preregistered)
blocks.zh: 4.2 研究 2(相关创作者,n=65n=65,预注册).

blocks.en: Only extraversion showed a significant effect in the predicted direction ( W = 588.0 W=588.0 , p = .041 p=.041 ), with descriptively lower distances in the known-voice condition ( M = 1.02 M=1.02 , S ​ D = 0.81 SD=0.81 , M ​ d ​ n = 1.00 Mdn=1.00 ) than in the unknown-voice condition ( M = 1.19 M=1.19 , S ​ D = 0.84 SD=0.84 , M ​ d ​ n = 1.00 Mdn=1.00 ). All other outcomes, including likability, competence, and trust, were not significant (Figure 2 ). Thus, the Study 1 effects for likability and agreeableness did not reappear in Study 2; instead, only extraversion showed the predicted effect.
blocks.zh: 只有外转显示在预测方向(W=588.0 W=588.0,p=.041 p=041)有显著影响,在已知的语音状态下描述距离(M=1.02 M=1.02,SD=0.81 SD=0.81,Mdn=1.00 Mdn=1.00)比在未知的语音状态下(M=1.19 M=1.19,SD=0.84 SD=0.84,Mdn=1.00 Mdn=1.00)低. 所有其他结果,包括可憎性、能力和信任,都不显著(图2)。 因此,第1项研究对易腐性和可接受性的影响没有在第2项研究中重新出现;相反,只有外向显示预测的效果。

blocks.en: 4.3 Qualitative Findings
blocks.zh: 4.3 定性结论

blocks.en: Open-ended responses from Study 2 were analyzed using qualitative content analysis [ 24 ] . Figure 3 shows the frequency of coded themes by voice condition.
blocks.zh: 利用定性内容分析对研究2的不限成员名额答复进行了分析[24]。 图3按语音条件显示编码主题的频率.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Frequency of coded themes in open-ended responses by voice condition. Numbers indicate mentions.
blocks.zh: 图3:按语音条件划分的开放式回复中编码主题的频率。 数字表示提及。

blocks.en: Recognition of the cloned voice was salient in the known-voice condition (17 mentions). Participants often acknowledged similarity to the familiar person while emphasizing deviations from the original voice, indicating imperfect perceived fidelity.
blocks.zh: 在已知的语音条件(17次提及)中,对克隆语音的认可是突出的。 与会者往往承认与熟人相似,同时强调偏离原声,表明认为的忠诚不完美。

blocks.en: Across both conditions, the dominant theme was visual rigidity and artificial facial movement (unknown: 15; known: 13 mentions). Participants described limited expression, stiffness, and, in some cases, an uncanny or unsettling impression, independent of voice familiarity.
blocks.zh: 在这两个条件中,占主导地位的主题是视觉刚性与人工面部运动(未知:15;已知:13提及). 与会者描述了有限的表达方式、僵硬性,有时还描述了一种令人不快或不安的印象,这种印象与语音熟悉程度无关。

blocks.en: Comments describing the voice as comparatively natural or pleasant were more frequent in the unknown-voice condition (5 vs. 1 mention), whereas voice–appearance mismatch was reported more often in the known-voice condition (3 vs. 1 mention).
blocks.zh: 将语音描述为相对自然或令人愉快的评论在无名语音条件(5对1提及)中更为常见,而在有名的语音条件(3对1提及)中,声音-出现不匹配的报告更为频繁。

blocks.en: Several participants questioned whether personality judgments were possible under the given conditions, suggesting perceived limits of trait attribution. In isolated cases, familiarity slightly attenuated negative impressions without reversing them. Distrust-related comments primarily referred to perceived misinformation rather than to the use of a familiar voice.
blocks.zh: 几位与会者对在特定条件下作出人格判断是否可行提出疑问,认为存在特性归属的限度。 在个别情况下,熟悉程度略微减轻了负面印象,但没有扭转这种印象。 与不信任有关的评论主要是指所察觉的错误信息,而不是使用熟悉的声音。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Ethical Implications
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和道德影响

blocks.en: Across both studies, familiar voice cloning produced only limited alignment between character ratings and memory-based ratings of the original speaker. Effects were selective, context-sensitive, and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. Interpreted through the conceptual distinction introduced earlier, the findings are therefore most consistent with identity activation , provide only weak evidence for trait transfer , and provide little evidence for person reconstruction .
blocks.zh: 在整个两项研究中,熟悉的语音克隆只能对原发言人的性格评级和基于记忆的评级进行有限的调整。 影响是选择性的、对背景有敏感认识的,没有在特征或研究背景中加以概括。 因此这些结论与身份激活最为一致, 仅为特征转移提供薄弱的证据,

blocks.en: The following sections discuss why familiar voices appear to function less as direct carriers of personality than as partial identity cues whose effects depend on the broader multimodal context.
blocks.zh: 以下各节讨论为什么熟悉的声音似乎不是作为人格的直接载体,而是作为影响取决于更广泛的多式联运背景的部分身份提示。

blocks.en: 5.1 A weak transfer channel under cue competition
blocks.zh: 5.1 国家 在提示竞争下一个薄弱的传输通道

blocks.en: Effects varied clearly by trait. Only extraversion 4 4 4 In personality psychology, extraversion refers to a tendency toward sociability, talkativeness, energetic behavior, and outward emotional expressiveness. In the Big Five framework, it is typically contrasted with introversion [ 13 ] . showed the predicted uncorrected directional effect in Study 2, whereas agreeableness and likability effects from Study 1 did not replicate. This difference may relate to the nature of familiarity with the speaker. In Study 1, participants knew the lecturer from direct interaction, likely resulting in richer and more stable person representations that extend beyond vocal cues. In contrast, familiarity with social media creators is typically mediated and may rely more strongly on cues such as voice and visual appearance. Under such conditions, vocal cues may play a comparatively larger role in shaping trait impressions, which may partly explain why extraversion showed the clearest difference in the online context. Extraversion is closely tied to acoustic parameters such as vocal effort, intensity, and dynamic variability, making it comparatively voice-diagnostic [ 27 , 36 ] . Traits such as agreeableness or likability may rely more strongly on broader behavioral cues and may therefore be less recoverable from voice alone.
blocks.zh: 影响因特点而明显不同。 只有extraversion 4 4 4 在人格心理学中,extraversion是指一种倾向于社交,说话,精力充沛的行为,以及外向情感表现的倾向. 在 " 大五 " 框架中,它通常与内向性[13]形成对照。 在研究2中,它显示了所预测的未经修正的方向效应,而研究1的可接受性和可喜性效应并没有复制。 这种差别可能与熟悉发言者的性质有关。 在研究1中,参与者从直接互动中了解讲师,这很可能导致更丰富和更稳定的个人表述,超越声调提示。 相形之下,对社交媒体创作者的熟悉通常是通过调解进行的,可能更依赖于语音和视觉外观等提示。 在这种情况下,声调提示在塑造特征印象方面可能发挥较大作用,这可以部分地解释为什么外传显示网上环境差异最大。 外传与声效,强度,动态变异等声学参数紧密相连,使其相对语音诊断[27,36]. 诸如可接受性或可喜性等特征可能更依赖于更广泛的行为提示,因此仅从声音中可能不太容易恢复。

blocks.en: At the same time, overall effect sizes were small. Qualitative responses indicate that perceived vocal artificiality and visual rigidity often shaped impression formation. Familiar listeners are known to hold relatively robust mental representations of familiar voices and can detect subtle deviations in prosody, timing, and accent [ 1 , 14 , 32 ] . When a cloned voice diverges from this stored prototype, attention may shift toward evaluating the authenticity of the voice rather than forming person-based impressions. This may also affect social evaluations such as perceived warmth or credibility.
blocks.zh: 同时,总体效果尺寸也很小. 定性反应表明,感知到的声素人工和视觉刚性常形成印象形成. 据了解,熟悉的听众持有相对强烈的熟悉声音的心理表现,并且能够检测出音节、时间和口音的微妙偏差[1、14、32]。 当克隆人的声音与这个存储的原型不同时,注意力可能转向评价声音的真实性,而不是形成基于人的印象. 这还可能影响社会评价,例如认为温暖或信誉。

blocks.en: Prior work suggests that technical imperfections draw attention to a voice’s artificiality [ 32 ] . While it has been shown that familiar voices in emotionally charged contexts can retain persuasive effects despite such deficits [ 38 ] , these findings were based on cases where listeners were exposed to audio cues only, so without a visual carrier that embodied the voice. Our studies suggest that coupling a familiar voice with an embodied character produces mismatch awareness that influences these relational effects.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作表明,技术不完善引起人们注意一个声音的人工性[32]. 虽然已经表明,在情感上充满感觉的场合中熟悉的声音可以保留说服力的效果,尽管存在这种缺陷[38],但这些结论是基于听众只接触音频提示的情况,因此没有体现声音的视觉载体。 我们的研究表明,将熟悉的声音与一个隐含的性格结合,会产生影响这些关系效应的错配意识.

blocks.en: 5.2 Using clones of familiar voices configures expectations more than it transfers traits
blocks.zh: 5.2 (中文(简体) ). 使用熟悉声音的克隆来配置期望比传输特征还要多

blocks.en: Interpreting the results of Studies 1 and 2 through the conceptual distinction introduced in section 2 helps clarify the mechanisms at work. Participants frequently recognized or commented on the familiar voice, indicating that identity activation occurred. The cloned voice triggered comparisons with the original speaker and shaped expectations about how the character should appear or behave.
blocks.zh: 通过第2节中引入的概念区分来解释研究1和研究2的结果有助于澄清工作机制。 与会者经常承认或评论熟悉的声音,表示身份激活已经发生。 克隆语音触发了与原发言人的比较,并塑造了对角色应如何出现或行为的期望.

blocks.en: Evidence for trait transfer was considerably weaker. Only a small number of traits showed significant alignment effects, and these effects were inconsistent across contexts. Rather than systematically projecting personality characteristics from the original speaker to the artificial character, participants appeared to rely primarily on cues present in the stimulus itself.
blocks.zh: 转让特性的证据相当薄弱。 只有少数特征显示出显著的配合效应,这些效应因背景而不一致。 参与者不但没有系统地将个性特征从原演讲者投射到人造人物身上,似乎主要依靠刺激本身的提示。

blocks.en: Most importantly, the data provide little to no evidence for person reconstruction . The familiar voice did not reinstate a broader person impression corresponding to the remembered individual. Instead, the cloned voice functioned as a recognizable cue that activated expectations while remaining embedded in a multimodal environment where other cues such as visual appearance and perceived artificiality strongly shaped evaluation.
blocks.zh: 最重要的是,数据对人的重建几乎没有任何证据。 熟悉的声音并没有恢复与被铭记的个人相对应的更广泛的个人印象。 相反,克隆语音是一种可识别的提示,它激活了期望,同时仍然嵌入一种多式联运环境中,在这种环境中,视觉外观和感知的人工性等其他提示具有强烈的定型评价。

blocks.en: Importantly, participants often recognized the speaker identity in the familiar voice condition. Their comments focused on appearance fit and comparison with the original person. This aligns with evidence that cloned familiar voices can pass categorical identity thresholds while still deviating from the richer stored prototype [ 10 , 14 , 19 , 32 ] . Recognition can be high even when synthetic origin is detected only modestly above chance. Identity activation does not require reliable authenticity detection [ 1 ] . Our data suggest that such activation mainly configures expectations about appearance and behavior rather than transferring the speaker’s broader trait profile.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,与会者往往在熟悉的语音条件下承认发言者的身份。 他们的评论集中在外表合适和与原人比较上. 这与克隆熟悉的声音能够通过绝对身份阈值同时仍然偏离更丰富的存储原型[10,14,19,32]的证据一致. 即使人工合成的原产地仅略高于机会,也会得到很高的识别。 身份激活不需要可靠的真实性检测[1]. 我们的数据显示,这种激活主要是为了配置对外表和行为的期待,而不是转移演讲者更广泛的特征。

blocks.en: In self-voice paradigms, similarity-based mechanisms increase likability and behavioral trust, often via perceived homophily and personification [ 16 , 35 ] . Third-party familiar voices introduce a stronger reference standard and invite prototype comparison. This amplifies scrutiny and highlights deviations in prosody, style, or interactional fit [ 10 , 14 ] . Under these conditions, a familiar voice may heighten mismatch salience without producing a reliable positive shift in applied evaluations.
blocks.zh: 在自我声音范式中,基于相似性的机理会增加可恋性和行为信任,通常通过感知的同质性和个性化[16,35]. 第三方熟悉的声音引入了更强的参考标准,并邀请原型比较. 这样做可以扩大审查范围,并凸显出音速、风格或相互作用的偏差[10、14]。 在这种情况下,熟悉的声音可能会加剧不匹配的显著性,而不会在应用评价方面产生可靠的积极转变。

blocks.en: 5.3 Boundary conditions suggested by the broader evidence
blocks.zh: 5.3 更广泛的证据所建议的边界条件

blocks.en: In the introduction, we raised the ethical concern that cloned voices could be used to strategically shape how people evaluate artificial characters. Prior research suggests, however, that such effects depend strongly on the surrounding context. When audiovisual cues are inconsistent, trust and believability decrease and uncanny impressions increase [ 12 , 34 ] . In contrast, when voice, appearance, and interaction quality are coherent, similarity cues have more opportunity to shape evaluation because they are less likely to be overshadowed by other concerns [ 3 , 14 , 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 在导言中,我们提出了伦理上的担忧,即克隆的声音可以用来战略性地塑造人们如何评价人造人物. 然而,先前的研究表明,这种影响在很大程度上取决于周围环境。 当视听提示不一致时,信任和可信程度降低,令人无法想象的印象增加[12,34]。 相比之下,当语音、外观和互动质量一致时,相似性提示就有更多的机会形成评价,因为它们不太可能被其他关切所掩盖[3、14、32]。

blocks.en: Our stimuli were intentionally controlled and relatively brief in order to isolate the effect of the voice cue. Even under these conditions, participants repeatedly reported that the available information was insufficient for reliable personality judgments. This suggests that short voice exposures alone may not provide enough information to support stable person-based projection. Rather than being inert, the effectiveness of known-voice cloning appears to depend on the broader cue environment. In particular, the visual appearance and behavioral coherence of the system deploying the voice may strongly constrain how the voice is interpreted. Alignment across multiple cues may therefore be required for familiar voices to meaningfully shape social evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们的刺激被有意控制 并且相对短暂 为了隔离语音提示的效果 即使在这种情况下,与会者也一再报告说,现有资料不足以作出可靠的人格判断。 这表明,仅靠简短的语音曝光可能无法提供足够的信息来支持稳定的基于人的预测。 已知语音克隆的有效性似乎取决于更广泛的提示环境,而不是惰性。 特别是,部署语音的系统的视觉外观和行为一致性可能强烈制约语音的解释方式. 因此,对于熟悉的声音来说,可能需要在多个线索之间保持一致,以便有意义地形成社会评价。

blocks.en: 5.4 Ethical implications
blocks.zh: 5.4 道德影响

blocks.en: Ethically, these findings qualify rather than eliminate concerns about familiar voice cloning. The data do not support the assumption that a familiar cloned voice alone is sufficient to make an artificial character appear socially continuous with the original speaker. However, recognizable voices can still activate identity-based expectations and can make mismatches between voice, appearance, and behavior more salient.
blocks.zh: 从道德上讲,这些结论符合资格,而不是消除对熟悉的语音克隆的关切。 数据并不支持这样的假设,即仅一个熟悉的克隆语音就足以使一个人造字符在社会上与原发音连续出现. 然而,可识别的声音仍然可以激活基于身份的预期,并使语音,外观和行为之间的不匹配更加突出.

blocks.en: This raises the question under what conditions cloned familiar voices should be used in social robotics and AI, if at all. What is it that a familiar voice could add to an artificial system that would enhance its capacities to function in a social context? One suggestion is that this use could increase the willingness to engage with systems meant to assist in educational and health practices. As we saw from our studies, however, the use of a familiar voice heightens awareness of the mismatch between the identity cue and the carrier of the voice. What is more, some participants stated that a mismatch between the voice and the carrier created uncanny or unsettling impressions (see section 4.3 ). Both of these findings make it likely that the use of a familiar voice would reduce the social functionality of the system rather than stimulate it. A further factor to consider is that especially in education and healthcare, users will be vulnerable. It might be that these users have more difficulty distinguishing reality from simulation, making it easier to manipulate them, or will be more affected by the uncanny or unsettling impressions. Given these factors, we therefore discourage the default use of familiar voices in social robotics, as well as their use without explicit consent.
blocks.zh: 这引起了一个问题,即克隆的熟悉的声音在什么条件下应该用于社会机器人和AI,如果有的话。 熟悉的声音能给人造系统增加什么,从而增强其在社会背景下发挥作用的能力? 一项建议是,这种使用可以增加参与旨在协助教育和保健做法的系统的意愿。 然而,我们从研究中看到,使用熟悉的声音提高了对身份提示和声音载体之间不匹配的认识。 更有甚者,一些与会者说,声音与载体之间的不匹配造成了令人无法想象或不安的印象(见第4.3节)。 这两个结论都使得使用熟悉的声音可能会减少系统的社会功能而不是刺激它. 另一个需要考虑的因素是,特别是在教育和保健方面,使用者将处于弱势。 这些用户可能更难将现实与模拟区分开来,从而更容易操纵它们,或者会受到令人不快或不安的印象的影响. 鉴于这些因素,我们因此劝阻在社会机器人方面默认使用熟悉的声音,以及未经明确同意使用这些声音。

blocks.en: At the same time, we acknowledge that voice cloning can have beneficial uses as well, like providing autonomy to people with speech impediments or voice loss by allowing them to communicate in a voice that they identify with [ 26 ] . We can even imagine scenarios in which users have the option to give a particular voice to a robot that they personally own. In both of these cases, the autonomy of the user is protected by turning the use of a familiar cloned voice into a choice . Even so, this should only be allowed under the condition that voice cloning itself is better regulated. To protect the autonomy of voice-owners, this entails developing transparent mechanisms to give consent for voice cloning, as well as the possibility to keep track of, update, and retract this consent. Additionally, the platforms that provide access to these voice cloning technologies should be properly monitored to ensure that they have these mechanisms in place. To protect the autonomy of the listeners, it is necessary to develop better mechanisms to detect impersonations of a person’s voice, also known as deepfakes [ 2 ] . Here, both non-technical mechanisms such as family/friend codewords [ 38 ] and technical mechanisms such as deepfake detectors that differentiate between human and synthetic voices [ 2 ] are promising candidates.
blocks.zh: 与此同时,我们承认,语音克隆也可以有有益的用途,例如,允许有语言障碍或语音丧失的人以他们认同的[26]个声音进行交流,从而为他们提供自主权。 我们甚至可以想象,在这样的情景中,用户可以选择给自己拥有的机器人一个特定的声音. 在这两种情况下,用户的自主权都通过将熟悉的克隆语音的使用变成一个选择而得到保护。 即使如此,只有在声音克隆本身得到更好的管理的条件下,才应允许这样做。 为保护语音拥有者的自主权,这就需要建立透明的机制,同意语音克隆,并有可能跟踪、更新和收回这种同意。 此外,应适当监测提供这些语音克隆技术的平台,以确保这些机制到位。 为了保护听众的自主性,有必要发展更好的机制来检测一个人的声音的冒名顶替,也被称为深假[2]. 在这里,家庭/朋友密码词等非技术机制[38] 和区别人类和合成声音的深假探测器等技术机制[2]都是有希望的候选人。

blocks.en: Finally, research into the effects of familiar voice cloning on personality transfer is bound to continue. We caution those pursuing this line of research to keep the following in mind:
blocks.zh: 最后,关于熟悉的语音克隆对人格转移的影响的研究必将继续下去。 我们提醒那些从事这一研究的人铭记:

blocks.en: • Treat a cloned familiar voice as a weak identity cue. Our results show no robust transfer of perceived personality, only small and selective alignment effects. • Multimodal coherence matters. Perceived artificiality and voice–appearance mismatch dominate judgments and override familiarity effects. • Consider selective bias. Even without broad personality transfer, recognizable voices can shift expectations and influence specific trait attributions.
blocks.zh: • 支助 将克隆熟悉的声音当作弱身份提示. 我们的结果表明,没有大力转移所认为的个性,只有小的和选择性的调整效果。 • 多式联运的一致性问题。 人造和声音的出现不匹配在判断和熟悉效果上占据主导地位。 • 考虑选择性偏见。 即使没有广义的人格转移,可识别的声音也能改变期望,影响特定特征归属.

blocks.en: Treat a cloned familiar voice as a weak identity cue. Our results show no robust transfer of perceived personality, only small and selective alignment effects.
blocks.zh: 将克隆熟悉的声音当作弱身份提示. 我们的结果表明,没有大力转移所认为的个性,只有小的和选择性的调整效果。

blocks.en: Multimodal coherence matters. Perceived artificiality and voice–appearance mismatch dominate judgments and override familiarity effects.
blocks.zh: 多式联运的一致性问题。 人造和声音的出现不匹配在判断和熟悉效果上占据主导地位。

blocks.en: Consider selective bias. Even without broad personality transfer, recognizable voices can shift expectations and influence specific trait attributions.
blocks.zh: 考虑选择性偏见。 即使没有广义的人格转移,可识别的声音也能改变期望,影响特定特征归属.

blocks.en: Even when broad trait transfer fails, recognizable voices can still activate expectations and subtly bias evaluations. The use of familiar voices in Human-Robot and AI interaction therefore requires transparency, consent, and careful attention to multimodal coherence.
blocks.zh: 即使在广义的特性转移失败时,可识别的声音仍然可以激活期望和潜伏的偏差评价. 因此,在人与机器人和人工智能互动中使用熟悉的声音需要透明度、同意和对多式联运一致性的认真关注。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 6 限制和未来方向

blocks.en: Several limitations should be considered. First, both studies relied on brief, single-exposure stimuli, approximately 14 s in Study 1 and 43 s in Study 2. This helped isolate the voice manipulation, but may have limited the formation of stable person-based impressions.
blocks.zh: 应当考虑若干限制。 首先,这两项研究都依靠简短的单一接触刺激,在研究1中约为14 s,在研究2中约为43 s。 这有助于孤立语音操控,但可能限制了稳定人物印象的形成.

blocks.en: Second, participants sometimes perceived the cloned voices and virtual characters as artificial. Such cues may have drawn attention away from personality attribution and toward authenticity or audiovisual fit.
blocks.zh: 第二,参与者有时将克隆的声音和虚拟人物视为人工的. 这种暗示可能使人们不再关注人格归属问题,而是关注真实性或视听问题。

blocks.en: Third, generalizability is limited by the sample sizes and study contexts. Study 1 involved a small university sample evaluating a single lecturer, while Study 2 examined online communities around two content creators. The observed trait-selective effects therefore require replication.
blocks.zh: 第三,通用性受样本大小和研究背景的限制. 第1研究涉及一个小的大学样本,评价一名讲师,而第2研究则在两个内容创建者周围检查在线社区. 因此,观察到的特征选择性效应需要复制。

blocks.en: Fourth, the studies focused on relatively specific forms of familiarity. Effects may differ for closer or more emotionally significant relationships, such as family members, close friends, or long-term colleagues. The findings are also limited to German-speaking contexts and explicit self-report measures.
blocks.zh: 第四,研究的重点是比较具体的熟悉形式。 对于亲属、亲密朋友或长期同事等关系,其影响可能有所不同。 调查结果还仅限于德语背景和明确的自我报告措施。

blocks.en: Future work should examine familiar voice cloning in longer and more naturalistic interactions, across different forms of embodiment, and in voice-only settings. It should also compare different relationship types, include cross-linguistic and cross-cultural replications, and complement self-report ratings with behavioral or implicit measures. These extensions would help clarify when familiar voice cues meaningfully shape social evaluation and when their influence remains constrained by the broader interaction context.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应审查人们熟悉的语音克隆,在较长和更自然的相互作用中,在各种表现形式中,以及在仅以语音为主的环境中。 还应比较不同的关系类型,包括跨语言和跨文化的复制,并以行为或隐含的措施补充自我报告评级. 这些扩展将有助于澄清在熟悉的语音提示有意义地塑造社会评价时,以及在它们的影响仍然受到更广泛的互动背景的限制时。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Voice cloning enables embodied characters to speak with the recognizable voice of a familiar person. Across two studies, we examined whether this familiarity leads listeners to transfer parts of their internal person model from the original speaker to the artificial character.
blocks.zh: 语音克隆能够使被体现的人物用熟人可识别的声音说话。 在两项研究中,我们研究了这种熟悉性是否导致听众将部分内部人物模型从最初的演讲者转移到人工角色.

blocks.en: Our findings provide little evidence for robust personality transfer. Effects were selective and did not generalize across traits or study contexts. Viewed through the conceptual framework introduced in this paper, the implementation of a familiar voice in an embodied artificial character appears to produce identity activation and, at most, limited trait transfer , while providing little evidence for person reconstruction .
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果为有力的人格转移提供了很少证据。 影响是选择性的,没有在特征或研究背景中加以概括。 从本文中引入的概念框架来看,用一个包含的人工特征来实施熟悉的声音似乎会产生身份激活和最多有限的特性转移,同时为人的重建提供的证据很少。

blocks.en: These results suggest that familiar voice cloning functions less as a mechanism for reproducing personality and more as a context-dependent identity cue. Recognizable voices can shape expectations and selectively influence evaluations, yet their effects remain constrained by factors such as perceived artificiality and voice–appearance coherence.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,熟悉的语音克隆功能较少作为复制人格的机制,而更多地作为依赖背景的身份提示。 可识别的声音可以塑造预期,并有选择地影响评价,但其影响仍然受到诸如人造性和声音的出现一致性等因素的限制。

blocks.en: From an ethical perspective, this moderates concerns that cloned familiar voices straightforwardly make artificial characters appear socially continuous with the individuals they resemble. At the same time, recognizable vocal identities can still activate trust-related expectations and subtly bias perception. Responsible deployment therefore requires clarity about the artificial system’s status and should avoid implying personal continuity or endorsement by the original speaker.
blocks.zh: 从伦理学角度来说,这温和了人们的关切,即克隆了熟悉的声音,直截了当地使人造人物与他们相似的个人在社会上不断出现。 同时,可识别的声波身份仍然可以激活与信任相关的期望和潜伏的偏执感. 因此,负责任的部署要求明确人工系统的地位,并应避免暗示个人的连续性或原发言人的认可。

blocks.en: A previous non-archival version of this work was presented as an extended abstract in the context of a non-archival poster [ 17 ] . That version already reported both empirical studies, including methodological information. The present paper builds on that empirical foundation but revises the framing and emphasis. While the data and core findings remain the same, the contribution is recontextualized for the Robophilosophy audience by focusing more explicitly on the limits of identity cue transfer, the conceptual implications of voice-based person reference, and the ethical positioning of embodied artificial characters.
blocks.zh: 之前本作的非存档版本在非存档海报[17] 的背景下被作为扩展抽象. 该版本已经报告了两项经验研究,包括方法信息。 本文件以这一经验为基础,但修订了框架和重点。 虽然数据和核心调查结果保持不变,但对Robophilosophy受众的贡献进行了重新编排,更明确地侧重于身份提示转移的限度、基于语音的人物参考的概念影响以及体现的人工人物的道德定位。
